rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a corporation or incorporated business.

example.english: This corporation has been operating for decades and is still the most famous one in our area.
example.traditional: 呢間公司做咗幾十年，仲係我哋區最出名嗰間。

rows.note: Pick this for the precise legal sense of an incorporated body rather than an ordinary business company.

example.english: Under the law, this corporation has an independent legal status.
example.traditional: 根據法例，呢個法團有獨立嘅法律地位。
